method.paid: 48 full paid campaigns, three paired seeds, two real repair unlocks, eight priorities. Source focus lasts 20 minutes then the frozen reference finishes. No injected progress or capital.
method.capacity: 60 fixtures, three seeds, two yards, ten staffed layouts. Same earned prefix and owned land; explicitly granted capital, real capped upgrades; 5 minute settling, 10 minute sales measurement. Capacity is not paid progression.
method.payback: Exact last-tier price gain at observed fixed physical sales volume, other prices fully upgraded. Excludes setup cost and assumes this volume persists; not a causal throughput test.
method.limits: Finite policy/layout search, not proven optimal. Three paired seeds per source comparison. Future random streams diverge after decisions. Main campaign shortcuts additionally checked on normal gameplay branches. No rendering, UI timers or cinematic.

manifest.method: 20 Hz actual game economy; one-second decisions; actual offers and charges; real research, letters and boarding; home/hollow/return; no grants, jumps or injected progress. Finale begins at finish; cinematic duration excluded. Seed resets each visit. Browser timers/rendering disabled.
